per_candidate.id: s2:Characterizing a World Within the Hot-Neptune Desert: Transit Observations of LT
s2:A Machine Learning Approach to Exoplanet Atmospheric Retrieval: Application to O

rationale: Paper 2404.15505 directly investigates the discrepancies in exoplanet transmission spectra by analyzing HST data and suggests stellar contamination as a widespread issue, contributing substantive evidence to part of the question. However, it does not fully resolve the question regarding the potassium feature and differences with other methods.
